decisions.rule: Every S_ir must use a route-specific declared denominator; output, population, capacity, route share, and maneuverability denominators are not interchangeable.
R_ir, C_r, and causal attribution are separate scientific objects.
Duration, recurrence, continuation evidence, memory, and irreversibility remain separate components rather than one generic multiplier.
Direction sign is universal; magnitude normalization must be frozen per domain before outcomes.
Use canonical event-route-time attribution units and dependency-graph allocation to prevent duplicate counting.
Aggregate changes within a route first, then combine routes under explicit critical-route gates.
Failure of an indispensable constitutive route cannot be offset by unrelated gains elsewhere.
Restoration requires intrinsic rebuilding and reduced dependency; supported output continuity is a separate state.
Condition is a stock and direction is a flow; both remain visible in the factorial system state Z_t.
Candidate measures include admissible reachable-state share, redundancy, restoration options, support dependence, and irreversible-transition risk.
